title: Estimate from deterministic query answers
statement: Given a restricted-weight input, a finite coordinate set $J$, a subset $S\subseteq J$, and a sign-valued answer for each valid query, define the estimate to be the average over outer indices $o$ of the square of the inner average. The inner average is the mean, over all inner indices $i$, of the answer at the query indexed by $(o,i)$ multiplied by the monomial indexed by $S$ evaluated at the free assignment associated with $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates in the input dimension
Answers assign a sign to every valid query
caveat: The definitions of the sign value, indexed monomial, free assignment, and query-index equivalence are not supplied, so their exact meanings cannot be stated independently.
